d:
A pregnancy Doujin that doesn't skimp the birth, and understands that the baby isn't (typically) launched out immediately after labor starts? Say it ain't so. This being the only one in the trilogy to not be translated was a shame, so here it is. Shame we didn't get to see Asako's birth though.

Thanks to Aishi21 for the quick delivery (hah) on the translation and letting me upload it. Their details are on the credit page at the end.
